jobs.description:
Why AMS?

We strive to do things better for the world’s most demanding brands. Is it challenging? Yes. But it’s a challenge that brings us together, where support, collaboration and inclusiveness empower you with a feeling of belonging.

Bring your goals and ambitions. We give you the trust, independence, and flexibility to run your career your way. Our support will bring you opportunity.

Our evolution is happening now, let’s bring it - together.

The Role:

We are currently looking for a Senior Recruiter with German (m/f/d) to support one of our client's – a market leader in investment banking – NatWest Group.

As a Senior Recruiter (m/f/d) you will support with the full end to end lifecycle (for all roles from Analyst to VP Level) via the direct delivery model ensuring Client, key hiring Managers stakeholders and candidates are supported throughout their lifecycle. You will also be supporting creating a talent strategy for your region and driving the achievement of all contractually agreed quality thresholds, SLAs and client satisfaction targets.

You’ll be reporting into a Senior Manager and be working alongside you colleagues across multiple regions as well as being a part of the wider NatWest UK AMS team. You will also have reporting lines into the NatWest HR Team in region.

Key Accountabilities:

- Taking full ownership to ensure the 360-recruitment service is delivered in line with contractual obligations and client service level agreements
- Leading vacancy consultation discussions to agree the recruitment plans with hiring managers– this includes role requirements, sourcing strategy, DEI requirements, pay range, agreed timeframes, responsibilities of all involved, and the selection process.
- Drive down the use of existing reliance on Agency a and educate the HM population on the benefits of direct delivery.
- Leveraging your existing experience, knowledge, and resources whilst also working with experts in sourcing and talent intelligence to develop effective sourcing strategies that enable you to deliver great candidates and lead and influence conversations with your hiring managers.
- Providing subject matter expertise, thought leadership and talent intelligence in recruitment discussions and vacancy briefing calls with Hiring Managers, leaving the discussion with a detailed understanding of the client’s business, the requirements and unique selling points of the role.
- Creating and maintaining trusted partner relationships with Senior hiring managers/stakeholders. Independent execution of the end-to-end delivery of recruitment services to them, providing counsel, advising through insight and SME knowledge on the recruitment process and ensuring that timelines are correctly identified and met
- Championing your candidates. Having honest, quality career discussions that assess candidate suitability for each role and bring your client’s brand to life so that candidates feel excited at the prospect of joining them

Critical Skills & Experience:

- Fluency in English and German, both written & spoken
- Experience in leading end-to-end 360 recruitment processes.
- Experience of sourcing and creating talent pools for future hiring.
- Strong customer focus and the ability to manage Client stakeholders including senior position
- Excellent communication skills and ability to build long-lasting relationships with candidates, clients, and teammates.
- Experience of hiring within Financial Services with preferably Investment Banking.

We strive to do things better for the world’s most demanding brands. Is it challenging? Yes. But it’s a challenge that brings us together, where support, collaboration and inclusiveness empower you with a feeling of belonging.

Bring your goals and ambitions. We give you the trust, independence, and flexibility to run your career your way. Our support will bring you opportunity.
Our evolution is happening now, let’s bring it—together!

FIWARE
The open source platform technology for our smart, digital future.

The FIWARE Foundation is a non-profit organization that drives the definition of open standards and promotes the introduction of open standards. These are implemented using open source technologies and reference architectures to facilitate the development of smart digital solutions in various areas based on FIWARE technology. The Foundation achieves this through the support of a rapidly growing global community that shares the FIWARE vision and actively supports making FIWARE the open source technology of choice for industry, governments, universities and associations. FIWARE is now the world's leading open source technology in the smart city sector.

Founded in 2016, the association counts Atos, aws, Engineering, NEC, Red Hat and Telefónica among its platinum members and currently employs around 45 people.

Your mission

As an Office and Accounting Manager (m/f/d) at the FIWARE Foundation, you will organize our documents and finances and work with external accounting. You will also support correspondence, managing and coordinating appointments, assisting colleagues with a wide range of administrative issues and processes and general office management.

Your tasks

● Preparatory accounting: You record incoming invoices and receipts, reliably process them and work with the accounting department for the monthly financial statements (DATEV)

● Administration: Independent performance of administrative tasks (written and telephone correspondence, filing, data maintenance), mail processing and distribution

● Assistance: You will provide support to the BOO colleagues, the administration and coordination of appointments, travel bookings and invoicing with a wide range of administrative issues and office matters

● Office management: You welcome guests, prepare for and follow up on meetings (prepare and clean the meeting space with drinks, coffee, snacks where appropriate), coordinate courier and supplier services and order office supplies

Your profile

● You have successfully completed commercial training or a comparable qualification and experience in preparatory accounting with at least 2 years of professional experience

● You have very good communication skills, a high degree of flexibility and a professional demeanour and impress with your trustworthy, committed and loyal personality

● You are characterized by a high level of service orientation and enjoy supporting your team and are willing to provide cross-departmental support

● You have an independent, structured and autonomous way of working and a talent for organization

● You are confident in using all Microsoft Office as well as Google Suite applications

● You have an open, communicative demeanour as well as a good way of expressing yourself and have very good written and spoken German and English skills (working language is English)

We offer

● Dynamic work and varied tasks in a friendly international environment

● Collaboration with several teams worldwide in a familiar and warm atmosphere

● The opportunity to work independently

● Growth opportunities

Type of position: Fulltime, permanent position
Place of work: On site in the FIWARE Foundation headquarters
Availability: Immediately

KLIFOVET GmbH, part of the Argenta Group, is a globally recognized supplier in the veterinary and feed sector based in Munich. We have made it our mission to competently accompany customers from the idea, through development, to approval and beyond. The service for our customers determines our actions. Since our founding in 1997, we have been awarded three times as the best service provider and the best contract research organization internationally.

About the role

The commercial project assistant role is a great opportunity to gain development within a dynamic and diverse team. Some of the key tasks you will be involved with are:

- Supporting project managers in the preparation and execution of clinical trials
- Procurement of study materials and office supplies
- Support of the departments in the area of shipping and logistics
- Support for data maintenance and data collection
- Documentation and archiving of study documents
- Labelling, dispensing, and administration of study medication
- First point of contact for customers and service providers on site and by telephone
- General office activities and support of in-house administrative processes

About you

By nature, you are a positive team player, embracing change and flexibility ensuring you are agile to meet the business demands.  You are reliable, and ambitious to learn new skills achieving the best you can in support of your team.

Experience and key skills

- A completed commercial apprenticeship or an apprenticeship in the pharmaceutical/medical field
- Solid knowledge in the use of MS Office programs
- Interest and curiosity to familiarize yourself with new tasks and areas of knowledge
- Independent, reliable and bring structure to your tasks
- Excellent German and English language skills, both written and verbal,  other foreign language skills are an advantage
- Customer-oriented, confident and positive appearance as well as open to having fun working in a team

We offer you a detailed introduction to your field of work, an independent, challenging and varied job, modern work equipment, family-friendly working hours, regular training and further education and a positive and collegial team in an appealing ambience in Munich.

If this sounds like an interesting role to you and you are looking for a new opportunity we would love to hear from you.  Please apply for this role via www.argentaglobal.com/careers

jobs.description:
Every day, our 21,000 heroes and sheroes ensuring that people in Germany feel safer. We at Securitas take care of you - because you take care of people's safety. We are currently recruiting several Security Officers (m/f/d) for our Global clients in Ludwigsfelde & Mittenwalde, Brandenburg.

Job Description
Your core tasks as a Security Officer:

Enforcement of security standards
Reception & front-of-house duties
Locking controls within the building, preventive fire protection and taking over the notification and reporting system
Working hours: 06:00 – 18:00 & 18:00 – 06:00 or 06:00 – 14:00, 14:00 – 22:00 & 22:00 – 06:00

Qualifications

Protection - with free Securitas group accident insurance - even in your free time

Modern clothing - with free, high-quality work and functional clothing

Always informed - with the Securitas online employee porta

Your application documents will be reviewed and processed by our recruiting team.

If you have any questions or other concerns, you can reach us by phone, Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00, at 030501000249.

This is who we are!

With our values of Honesty, Attentiveness and Helpfulness, our goal is to make the world a safer place.

Securitas stands for equal opportunities and diversity!

As a signatory to the Diversity Charter, we reject discrimination of any kind and look forward to receiving applications and working with people - regardless of gender, sexual orientation, ethnic and social background, age, disability, religion or ideology.

jobs.occupation: Data Center Technician / Strasbourg Grad Est France (Techniker/in - Informatik (technische Informatik)/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
jobs.description:
Data Center Technician

R019729
Strasbourg, Grand Est, France
Regular
Apply Now
Location Details: France, Strasburg

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This is an in-office position and you’ll be expected to work full-time in an office location, and therefore must live within commuting distance from your assigned office. You will work from this office beginning on your first day.

Join our team

As Data Center Technician will be the technical liaison between the technology teams and the data center environment. You will work a flexible shift 24/7 in a rolling system.

What you'll get to do…

You perform hardware troubleshooting, maintenance as well as data and power cable management, testing, and installation for GoDaddy infrastructure, with a focus on critical systems (storage, network, servers) and you are able to solve all but the most sophisticated infrastructure issues
You maintain documentation on technologies you support and understand all aspects of the equipment
You respond to all requests from 24x7 business operations centers and work according to policies and procedures
You ensure detailed physical inventory tracking and staging (Inventory and Asset Management) while performing cycle audits within our system (ServiceNow)
You perform Disk Life Cycle process and destruction of data bearing devices following our policies
You coordinate with suppliers to initiate warranty claim and process failed vendor hardware devices
Your experience should include…

Validated expertise in systems administration (Linux and/or Windows Servers) and networking (DNS, DHCP)
1+ years experience with the following IT hardware concepts: RAID, Storage Concept, SAS/SATA/NVME, Boot Process, Boot Loader, Base Operating System Install, Network device and protocol configuration, File Systems, Directory Structure, Core OS Services such as SSH, Telnet, RDP, FTP, NFS, DNS, DHCP, LDAP
The ability to kneel, crawl, reach above shoulder height and lift 25kg repeatedly throughout daily shifts and walk/move about the data center facility for up to 85% of shift time
Verbal and written communication skills in English
You might also have…

Basic Linux OS knowledge
Basic Windows OS knowledge
Basic command line troubleshooting knowledge
We've got your back...  We offer a range of benefits that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in an employee stock purchase plan, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.

We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (Culture). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way.

About us...  GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us.

At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our Diversity Careers page.

GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements. Refer to our full EEO policy.

Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com.

GoDaddy doesn’t accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.

jobs.employer_name: Visa Europe Management Services German Branch Ltd.
jobs.description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world.  Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Manager, Client Success & Eurozone Operations is a hybrid individual contributor role that combines strategic client engagement with support for key Eurozone priorities. Reporting to the Head of Client Services Central Europe and Eurozone Operations, the role supports strategic priorities, transformational initiatives and cross-functional programs, helping to ensure the effective execution of operational and business objectives across the Eurozone and contributing to continued compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.

The position supports the design, coordination, management and delivery of high-profile activities and strategic or transformational initiatives that require collaboration across multiple business functions. A central part of the Eurozone responsibilities is supporting regulatory readiness, coordinating compliance-related activities and helping ensure that relevant requirements, actions and dependencies are understood, tracked and progressed through the appropriate channels. Success in this role requires the ability to build strong partnerships, influence without direct authority and work effectively with stakeholders across Client Services, Product, Technology, Risk, Operations and other European and Global functions.

Alongside these responsibilities, the role serves as a trusted advisor to an assigned portfolio of clients, helping them optimize operational performance, adopt new capabilities and maximize the value of their relationship with Visa.

This role offers broad exposure across European and Global functions, regular interaction with experienced leaders and the opportunity to build capabilities in Client Success, regulatory readiness, strategic execution, transformation and stakeholder management. It is well suited to a high-performing professional who is ready to take ownership within a defined scope and contribute effectively from day one.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Success

- Support and/or oversee the implementation of new Visa products the Client purchases by coordinating key Client and Visa teams to expedite implementation readiness activities and steer the client toward getting faster time to value and maximize adoption of deployed products. 
- Ensure Client operational goals and success metrics for their overall Visa product landscape are understood. 
- Build and sustain a client advocate status with key client stakeholders by proactively executing against forward-looking Client Success Plans, in alignment with the Account Team, to track client specific outcomes including a client’s adoption and performance of Visa products purchased. 
- Participate in the design and delivery of initiatives to improve client adoption of products and use of Visa’s self-tools. 
- Stay current with the latest payment processing trends, Visa solutions and technologies to provide a good Client experience and generate new sales leads as solutions to identified client pain points. 
- Establish working relationships with Client Services and other cross-functional subject matter experts to orchestrate consultation to resolve complex client issues and optimize client performance. 
- Support development of client education and training materials (including webinars) to communicate new Visa Rules, essential mandates, Visa Business Enhancement Releases and/or upcoming changes to ensure client readiness and service compliance.  
- Support and/or lead periodic operational reviews with clients and Visa stakeholders. 
- Act, on an ad-hoc and as needed basis for applicable clients, as the escalation point for managing significant issues and major incident/crisis responses. 
- Proactively identify and drive opportunities to optimize client performance by monitoring client health and liaising with specialist Visa teams as needed. 
- Play the role of the overall Client Services main point of contact for colleagues and clients in your market.
- Deliver Operational Resilience Support - to disseminate approved Corporate Communications’ messages to clients and maintain ongoing interaction with clients to meet their specific needs throughout a crisis event, coordinating and escalating queries where appropriate (as per agreed Crisis Management Plan). 

Eurozone Operations and Strategic Initiatives

- Support the Head of Eurozone in progressing agreed strategic priorities and operational objectives.
- Support the design, coordination, management and delivery of strategic and transformational initiatives, including high-profile activities with visibility across senior leadership.
- Support regulatory readiness and the coordination of activities required to help maintain compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
- Coordinate cross-functional workstreams, plans, milestones, dependencies, risks and actions to support timely delivery of agreed outcomes.
- Prepare clear analysis, insights, recommendations and management updates to support decision-making and stakeholder discussions.
- Create and tailor a broad range of recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, presentations and briefing materials for different stakeholder groups, including senior stakeholders, ensuring information is accurate, relevant and clearly communicated.
- Support Eurozone operational readiness, governance and change activities while maintaining an appropriate level of confidentiality.
- Build strong partnerships and collaborate closely with stakeholders across European and Global functions
- Facilitate alignment between teams, clarify ownership and help resolve delivery challenges through structured coordination and follow-up
- Represent relevant client and Client Success perspectives in cross-functional initiatives and change activities.
- Translate complex regulatory, operational, technical and business topics into clear implications, actions and communications for different audiences.
- Maintain effective action tracking and escalate material risks, issues, compliance matters or dependencies through the appropriate channels.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

- Relevant professional background, combined with a Bachelor’s degree or an advanced degree (e.g., Master’s, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD).
- Background in Client Success, Client Services, payments, operations, product, consulting, program management, risk, compliance or a related field.
- Proven ability to coordinate and deliver cross-functional projects, workstreams or business initiatives in a matrix organization.
- Previous work in a regulated environment, including support for regulatory, compliance, governance or operational readiness activities.
- Strong track record of managing client or stakeholder relationships and translating business needs into clear actions and deliverables.
- Strong partnership-building and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
- Sound analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information and develop practical recommendations.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage stakeholders at different levels and present information clearly.
- Strong planning, organization and execution discipline, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies and deadlines.
- Ability to work independently within an agreed scope, exercise sound judgment and seek guidance or escalate when appropriate.
- Ability to navigate ambiguity, adapt to changing priorities and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
- Knowledge of payments, financial services, fintech, technology or consulting environments.
- Exposure to strategic, transformational, change or operational improvement initiatives.
- Proven ability to collaborate with regional and global stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies.
- Understanding of transaction processing, client operations, operational resilience, regulatory compliance or regulated operating environments.
- Familiarity with regulatory governance, compliance monitoring, risk management or control frameworks.
- Knowledge of project management, change management or process improvement approaches.
- Ability to create and tailor management reports, dashboards, presentations and briefing materials for varied audiences, including senior stakeholders.
- Working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with tools such as Power BI or Tableau is beneficial.
- Fluent English and German required.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Visa welcome and encourages application from persons with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

📍 Location: Remote (Germany / Austria/ Other European Countries)
⏱️ Type of Employment: Full-time

Harris means choice, expertise & relationship. Choice among industry leading software solutions. Expertise from our employees who are industry, regulatory and domain experts. Relationships for the long term.  We want our customers to be customers for life, and we focus on creating customer experience that will deliver on this goal. We combine choice, expertise & relationship with profitable growth and an environment of openness, trust and credibility. At Harris, we do the right thing when it comes to our customers and our employees.

We invite you to join us and be a part of our exciting journey! We are looking for a Talent Development & Learning Specialist to join our HR International team. This will be remote work.  

We are looking for a passionate and creative Talent Development & Learning specialist to join our team. The role will focus on designing and delivering impactful behavioral learning experiences that help employees and leaders build critical capabilities and perform at their best. 

The ideal candidate understands adult learning principles, can translate business needs into engaging learning solutions, and is comfortable creating training content using both traditional as well as modern methodologies. 

What will be your impact? 

Learning Needs Analysis 

- Partner with business leaders, HR Business Partners, and managers to identify capability requirements and skill gaps
- Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA) using business inputs, employee feedback, performance data, and organizational priorities
- Translate identified needs into relevant learning interventions and development plans

Behavioral Training Design & Content Development 

- Design and develop behavioral and soft-skills programs from concept to delivery
- Create training content, participant materials, activities, case studies, assessments, and learning modules
- Develop programs covering areas such as communication, influencing, leadership, collaboration, stakeholder management, executive presence, coaching and feedback, conflict management, change management, decision-making, and professional effectiveness
- Apply adult learning, instructional design, and experiential learning principles

Training Delivery & Facilitation 

- Design and facilitate instructor-led, virtual, in-person, and blended learning programs
- Deliver onboarding and employee development programs 
- Use engaging methodologies such as discussions, role plays, simulations, and case studies
- Continuously improve programs based on learner feedback and outcomes

Learning Programs & E-Learning 

- Support the design and implementation of onboarding, e-learning, leadership development, and other talent development programs
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners to develop scalable learning solutions
- Leverage digital learning platforms and emerging technologies to enhance the learning experience

Learning Effectiveness & ROI 

- Define measures to evaluate learning effectiveness and business impact
- Track participation, completion, learner feedback, skill improvement, and application of learning
- Analyze learning data and report on program effectiveness and ROI
- Use insights to continuously improve learning solutions

Workday Learning 

- Working knowledge of Workday Learning, with the ability to independently manage learning programs, courses, learner assignments, training records, reporting, and day-to-day L&D administration

What are we looking for? 

- AI & Innovation Mindset - We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and deliver stronger business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt AI-enabled tools to improve workflows, solve problems, support decision-making, and increase efficiency. They should be comfortable incorporating these technologies into their day-to-day work while applying appropriate professional judgment and adhering to relevant security, confidentiality, and compliance requirements
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Organizational Psychology, Education, Business Administration, or a related field
- 2–4 years of relevant experience in Learning & Development, Talent Development, Training, or Organizational Development
- Demonstrated experience designing and delivering behavioral/soft-skills training
- Experience independently creating learning content and training materials
- Experience in a multinational/corporate environment is an advantage
- Location: Remote – Germany / Austria/ Other European Countries 
- Travel: ~30% within and outside base location  
- Willing to work flexible hours to provide support to other geographies  
- Languages: German & English – Expert level; French working knowledge is an advantage 
- Employment Type: Full-time  

Key Skills & Competencies 

- Strong facilitation, presentation, and communication skills
- Strong instructional design and content development capabilities 
- Ability to create behavioral training programs from scratch
- Good understanding of adult learning principles and methodologies
- Strong stakeholder management and consulting skills
- Ability to conduct TNA and translate business needs into learning solutions
- Data-driven approach to measuring learning effectiveness
- Ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams
- Creative, curious, and passionate about employee development
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, multicultural, multinational environment
- Willing to travel for work in and outside Germany

What Success Looks Like 

Understand the business → Identify capability gaps → Design the right learning solution → Create compelling content → Facilitate impactful experiences → Measure learning and business impact.

jobs.occupation: 586958 Systems Engineer & Technologist (all genders) (Forschungs- und Entwicklungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
In this role, you will provide technical leadership for the development and lifecycle management of X-ray tubes, generators, and their subcomponents. By translating customer and business needs into robust system solutions and collaborating across multidisciplinary teams, you will help deliver innovative, reliable imaging technologies that drive Philips' success and create value for customers.

Your role: 

- Define, introduce, and maintain system architectures for x-ray tubes, generators, and X-segments, including interfaces, system requirements, and modular building blocks. 
- Translate stakeholder, user, and business needs into clear, measurable, and traceable product requirements and design decisions. 
- Drive technology choices, design trade-off analyses, and the selection of suitable methods and tools to deliver balanced, robust solutions. 
- Lead system integration and verification, including the management of requirements, interfaces, and deviations through to system readiness. 
- Own technical and product risk assessments, define mitigations, and implement relevant medical standards and regulatory requirements – working across functions and with suppliers to continuously improve quality, reliability, and manufacturability. 

You should bring the following: 

- Master's degree or PhD in Engineering, Physics, Electrical, Mechanical, or a related technical field, with 5–10 years of relevant R&D experience.
- Strong expertise in high-voltage X-ray generator design, power electronics, embedded systems, digital control, or X-ray tube technology.
- Solid knowledge of physics, mechanical and electrical design, with strong analytical and systems architecture skills.
- Experience with requirements management tools and systems engineering methodologies.
- Proven technical leadership experience, with excellent stakeholder management, networking, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
- Business-fluent in English and German, with the ability to manage complexity, influence stakeholders, and drive results.

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is €118,606–€121,210. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations. 

This role is eligible for Short Term Incentive, with your rewards linked to individual performance and company results. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision.

Philips benefits for you: 

- Annual leave: 30 days  
- Mobility and devices: subsidized Germany ticket, leasing opportunities for private use (bicycles, cars, smartphones,…) 
- Philips University & Philips in Balance: Wide range of professional training courses and for personal development & Healthcare 
- Philips Pension Fund: Employer-funded pension plan  
- “Partnerzeit” – two paid weeks off after your partner has given birth

Constructor University (formerly Jacobs University) is a private, state-accredited, English-language university in Bremen. We offer Bachelor, Master, and PhD programs in three schools: School of Science, School of Computer Science and Engineering, and School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences. Our principles are first-class teaching and research, international diversity, and multidisciplinary cooperation. Constructor University consistently achieves top results in national and international university rankings. As an international university, we attract highly talented and open-minded students from all over the world. Currently, over 1.800 students from 110 nations live and study on our residential campus.

Constructor University is seeking to fill a tenure-track faculty position in organic chemistry with a focus on synthetic organic chemistry, and we invite applications from interested candidates for the following position, to be filled ideally by January 2027:

Assistant Professor of Organic Chemistry (f/m/d)
(full-time, tenure-track, initially limited to 3 years)

Your Responsibilities:

The School of Science is particularly interested in a candidate who combines experimental and computational or theoretical approaches for the development of synthetic methodology and synthesis of bioactive molecules or functional materials. The implementation of AI, machine learning, or data-driven control / optimization is highly welcome, for example, for synthesis planning, activity prediction, sensing, or structural topology. The successful candidate is expected to engage in innovative research in organic chemistry and to maintain a cutting-edge, externally funded research program that energizes the School of Science.

The successful candidate will conduct teaching in the field of organic chemistry, including fundamental and advanced lectures and laboratories at the BSc, MSc, and PhD level. The expertise in teaching organic chemistry forms an integral part of the basic education in the BSc programs “Chemistry and Biotechnology” and “Medicinal Chemistry and Chemical Biology”. Moreover, the candidate is expected to take a pivotal role in the MSc programs “Quantitative Life Science” and/or “Advanced Materials” with complementary research experience and via the development and implementation of innovative, pedagogically sound approaches to online, hybrid and in-person teaching and learning. This will also include the advising of students on their studies, and the supervision of Bachelor, Master, and PhD theses as well as research projects.

The university is highly supportive of junior faculty, providing both formal and informal mentoring, administrative support, as well as a flexible budget for establishing an internationally visible research group. The University offers in-house adequate shared analytical research facilities, including NMR spectrometers, single crystal diffractometers, and high-resolution mass spectrometers.

- PhD degree in Organic Chemistry
- Strong publication record in relevant international journals
- Experience in the acquisition of third-party funding is desirable

jobs.occupation: Account Manager Powerwall, Frankfurt am Main, Germany (m/w/d) (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

Tesla is seeking an Account Manager for residential energy sales in Germany. Your core responsibility is B2B sales of Tesla residential and small commercial energy products, with a primary focus on Powerwall 3P — Tesla’s three-phase home battery and integrated inverter, purpose-built for the German and European grid. Following the launch of Powerwall 3P in Germany, you will scale adoption through distributors and third-party installers, grow a high-performing partner network, and drive business development in your region. We are looking for an experienced commercial professional with a background in PV or energy storage. Beyond strong execution and a team-oriented mindset, successful candidates bring creativity, passion, and the drive to lead in a fast-moving technology and market landscape. * This position can be based anywhere in Germany.

What You’ll Do

- Achieve Powerwall 3P and Wall Connector sales targets within assigned channel(s) in Germany
- Build and grow relationships across partner organizations (distributors, installers, and related channels), clearly communicating Tesla’s product portfolio, three-phase value proposition, and feature roadmap
- Drive partner readiness and ramp for Powerwall 3P: onboarding, enablement, pipeline building, and conversion from interest to installed systems
- Evaluate new business opportunities with existing and new accounts and/or sales channels, match suitable product offerings (including Powerwall 3P for three-phase residential and small commercial sites), and own capture of those opportunities
- Deliver market insights to the broader business — including competitive dynamics, installer feedback, and adoption barriers/opportunities specific to three-phase storage in Germany
- Provide accurate sales forecasts to business and manufacturing teams, reflecting Powerwall 3P ramp and channel mix
- Support assessment of market dynamics across sectors (utility, C&I, residential) and drivers (policy/regulatory, economics, grid requirements, incentive programs)
- Represent Tesla at sales and marketing events promoting Powerwall and Powerwall 3P
- Identify and support initiatives that improve partner training, installation quality, fulfilment, and Tesla support — with particular focus on three-phase design, commissioning, and backup use cases
- Provide user and customer feedback to IT on Tesla tools/systems and to Operations on processes

What You’ll Bring

- 5+ years in account management or channel sales within the PV or energy storage industry
- Strong understanding of residential/small commercial energy storage, ideally including three-phase (3P) systems, hybrid inverters, and grid-tied architectures common in Germany
- Working knowledge of grid/utility markets, grid connection practices, and relevant German/EU regulatory and incentive frameworks
- Excellent communication and documentation skills
- Ability to prioritize and run multiple projects and partner workstreams in parallel
- Fluency in English and German
- Flexibility to travel within Germany (and occasionally the broader region)

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.
